summary: Iteration 2 re-test of ShortCut AI Phase 2.1. All 3 critical bugs from iteration 1 are FIXED and verified. Backend pytest suite 22/22 PASS (8.74s). Critical bug A — duplicate-signup 500 on users.google_id index — fixed via partialFilterExpression in db/indexes.py (drops legacy sparse index on startup and recreates as partial-unique-on-$type:string); verified by signing up Alice then Bob in the same session (both 201). Critical bug B — refresh-token DuplicateKeyError on sessions.refresh_token_hash — fixed by adding jti=uuid4().hex to the JWT payload in core/security._issue_token; verified by /auth/refresh immediately after signup (200, rotates both tokens). Critical bug C — Metro /assets reserved path collision — fixed by renaming Expo Router segment /app/frontend/app/assets/ → /app/frontend/app/library/; all router.push('/assets...') call sites updated to '/library'; /library now loads cleanly with the 'Upload your first asset' empty state. testID renames verified live in DOM: auth-signin-submit-button (signin), studio-new-project-fab (studio FAB), and the full new-project-* family in the project wizard (back, title, title-input, content-chip-*, mode-*, style-chip-*, platform-chip-*, prompt-input, submit-button). No regressions detected. No new bugs found. App ready for next phase.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing dev-mode console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking, not surfaced in this run; carries over from iteration 1 if still present in any third-party component.

critical_code_review_comments: core/security.py:35 — jti=uuid4().hex added to JWT payload; refresh-token collision fix confirmed.
db/indexes.py:5-20 — _ensure_partial_unique drops legacy sparse index and recreates as partial unique on $type:string; idempotent on cold start.

frontend/app/library/index.tsx — route rename complete; all router.push sites updated. testID family is still 'assets-*' (assets-back, assets-upload-button, assets-empty-upload-button, assets-filter-chip-*) — this is internally consistent and matches the screen's domain ('Asset Library'), so no rename needed unless PRD asks for 'library-*'.

frontend/app/(auth)/sign-up.tsx — input testIDs are 'auth-name-input', 'auth-email-input', 'auth-password-input' (shared with sign-in), not 'auth-signup-name-input' etc. Reasonable since they are conceptually the same component; flag only if PRD demands per-screen prefixes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (signup, dashboard, library empty state, studio FAB, new-project wizard, sign-in all OK)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests dynamically create users with prefixes test_/e2e_/stu_/alice_/bob_ etc. demo@shortcut.ai still not pre-seeded (see iteration_1 note); not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/, run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Auth screens share testIDs: auth-name-input / auth-email-input / auth-password-input across sign-up and sign-in (sign-in just lacks the name field). Library route is /library (NOT /assets); empty-state CTA testID is 'assets-empty-upload-button' (kept assets- prefix on the screen-level testIDs even though the route is /library). Wizard testIDs all use 'new-project-' (hyphenated) prefix.
rca_of_issue: All 3 root causes from iteration_1.json have been addressed at the source: (1) partialFilterExpression replaces sparse on google_id so null docs are not indexed; (2) jti claim makes every refresh JWT byte-unique even within the same second so SHA256(refresh_token) cannot collide; (3) Expo Router segment renamed off Metro's reserved /assets/* path. Verified via both pytest (22/22) and live Playwright walk-through against the public preview URL.
